voiceover: New on Apologia Daily: Bible references across the site are now tappable. Tap Joel 2:32, and the verse opens right there on the page. You never leave what you're reading. Then tap Romans 10, verses 9 to 13. That last line quotes Joel 2:32. Paul takes a text about calling on the covenant name of God and, without a word of apology, makes it a text about calling on Jesus. It works inside Evidence Library cards, without closing the card. On answer pages. And on Mastery Tracks. Want the original language? Each verse links to STEP Bible, a free study tool. Switch on the interlinear, and you can see the Greek word by word. Here, Lord is Kyrios. And the Hebrew behind it. In Joel 2:32, the Lord upon whose name one calls is Yahweh himself. The verse text is the Berean Standard Bible, in the public domain. Scripture, one tap away, at apologiadaily.com.
